en-US.title: Up to 12 Wallets for PumpFun Bundling
en-US.desc: PumpFun bundling now supports up to 12 wallets at the same time.

en-US.title: Shortcut Cooking
en-US.desc: The Cooking Panel now supports one-click cooking with a keyboard shortcut.

en-US.title: Aster Pair Support on Four
en-US.desc: Four now supports Aster trading pairs.

en-US.title: Snipe and Bundle Together
en-US.desc: Four and PumpFun now support sniping and bundling at the same time.

en-US.title: Quoted Keyword Quick Cooking
en-US.desc: AI keyword detection for tweets now supports one-click cooking from keywords inside quotation marks.

en-US.title: 13-Character Support on PumpFun
en-US.desc: PumpFun now supports up to 13 characters.

en-US.title: Agent Mode on PumpFun
en-US.desc: PumpFun now supports Agent Mode cooking.

en-US.title: Clipboard CA Auto Refresh
en-US.desc: When the Cooking Panel is open, shortcut suggestions will update automatically if a new CA address is copied to the clipboard.

en-US.title: Quick Cooking in Token Search
en-US.desc: The token search popup now supports quick token info copy and one-click cooking.

en-US.title: ASCII Fallback for Tweet Monitoring
en-US.desc: Tweet monitoring now prioritizes ASCII images when no image is available.

en-US.title: Auto Symbol Generation from Name
en-US.desc: In the token creation panel, entering a coin name will automatically generate the ticker.

en-US.title: AI Keyword One-Click Cooking
en-US.desc: Tweet monitoring now supports AI-generated keywords based on tweet content for one-click cooking.

en-US.title: New Cooking Panel UI
en-US.desc: The Cooking Panel has been updated with a new UI and now supports resizing and dragging.

en-US.title: Pump Fee Split Presets
en-US.desc: Pump fee split presets are now supported.

en-US.title: Quick Copy for Fee Split Params
en-US.desc: Fee split parameters can now be quickly copied in trench scenarios.

en-US.title: Quick Fill X Account for Flap / Bags
en-US.desc: X accounts can now be filled in quickly when entering fees for Flap / Bags.
